title: Uakifishi (Theme 3: Mapambo)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child decides what kind of sentence it is and gives it a capital at the start, the right end mark, capitals on names and commas in lists.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a sentence with a full stop.
floor.question: Andika: tunapenda shule

steps: Capital at the start and on names.
Commas in lists, mark at the end.

board.do: je wanjiru amenunua shanga bangili na hereni
Point at the first word and the list.
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Je, Wanjiru amenunua shanga, bangili na hereni?"

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi." Kwa nini "wanjiru alienda sokoni." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Sentensi huanza kwa herufi kubwa, na majina ya watu na mahali pia huandikwa kwa herufi kubwa.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi." Kwa nini "Unaenda wapi." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Swali humalizika kwa kiulizi (?). Sentensi ya kawaida humalizika kwa kikomo (.).

listen_for: Mama alinunua mchele sukari na chumvi.
misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi." Kwa nini "Mama alinunua mchele sukari na chumvi." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Koma hutenganisha vitu katika orodha. Weka koma baada ya kila kitu isipokuwa kabla ya "na" ya mwisho.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi." Kwa nini "Tulienda Shule asubuhi." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Herufi kubwa hutumika mwanzo wa sentensi na kwa majina ya pekee tu. Nomino ya kawaida katikati ya sentensi huandikwa kwa herufi ndogo.

checks.question: Sentensi inayouliza huishia kwa alama gani?
